The season began on 3 March 2013 and finished on 31 August 2013.{{cite web|url=http://vietnamnews.vn/Sports/233894/v-league-cuts-teams-for-new-season-to-start-next-march.html |title=V-League cuts teams for new season to start next March |work=Vietnam News |date=December 10, 2012 |access-date=December 10, 2012}} {{TOC limit|3}} ==Changes from last season== ===Team changes=== The following teams have changed division since the 2012 season. {{col-begin|width=auto}} {{col-2}} ====To V.League 1==== '''Promoted from [[2013 V.League 2|V.League 2]]''' * [[Berjaya Đồng Nai F.C.|Đồng Nai]] * [[Đồng Tâm Long An F.C.|Đồng Tâm Long An]] {{col-break|gap=5em}} ====From V.League 1==== '''Folded''' * [[Hà Nội F.C. (1956)|Hà Nội]] * [[Khatoco Khánh Hòa F.C.]] * [[Navibank Sài Gòn F.C.|Navibank Sài Gòn]] {{col-end}} '''Relegated''' * [[TDCS Đồng Tháp F.C.|TĐCS Đồng Tháp]] ===Rule changes=== After a 5-year absence, the [[Asian Football Confederation|AFC]] announced that the V.League 1 champions would be allowed to compete in the [[2014 AFC Champions League]] playoff stage.{{cite web|url=http://vietnamnews.vn/sports/248240/tt-ready-for-regional-challenge.html |title=T&T ready for regional challenge |work=VietNamNews.vn |date=November 29, 2013}} == Teams == Number of participating clubs in the 2013 campaign is 12. [[Hải Phòng F.C.|Vicem Hải Phòng]]'s relegation to the [[2013 Vietnamese First Division]] season was confirmed on 29 July 2012. However, the club returned to the V.League for the 2013 season after purchasing [[Khatoco Khánh Hòa F.C.|Khatoco Khánh Hòa]]'s slot, who later dissolved on 8 December 2012.{{cite web |url=http://english.vietnamnet.vn/fms/sports/54699/football-federation-fixes-the-v-league-2013-plan.html |title=Football Federation fixes the V-League 2013 plan |work=Vietnamnet Bridge |date=December 13, 2012 |access-date=December 13, 2012 |archive-date=January 18, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180118010353/http://english.vietnamnet.vn/fms/sports/54699/football-federation-fixes-the-v-league-2013-plan.html |url-status=dead }} [[Đồng Tháp F.C.|TĐCS Đồng Tháp]] were relegated after rivals [[Khatoco Khánh Hòa F.C.|Khatoco Khánh Hòa]] defeated [[Sông Lam Nghệ An F.C.|Sông Lam Nghệ An]] 1–0 on 19 August 2012.{{cite web |url=http://talkvietnam.com/2012/08/shb-danang-win-dramatic-v-league-title-dong-thap-relegated/#.ULvt-eQ0WSo |title=SHB Danang win dramatic V-League title, Dong Thap relegated |work=Talk Vietnam |date=August 20, 2012 |access-date=December 2, 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160827093659/https://www.talkvietnam.com/2012/08/shb-danang-win-dramatic-v-league-title-dong-thap-relegated/#.ULvt-eQ0WSo |archive-date=August 27, 2016 |url-status=dead }} [[Đồng Tâm Long An F.C.|Đồng Tâm Long An]] (as Champions) and [[Ha Noi F.C. (2011)|Hà Nội T&T B]] (as runners-up) secured direct promotion to the V.League from the [[2012 Vietnamese First Division]]. Đồng Tâm Long An returned to the V.League after a one-season absence. However, [[Ha Noi F.C. (2011)|Hà Nội T&T B]] remained in the second tier of Vietnamese football due to league rules about clubs with the same owners competing in the same division. [[Hà Nội F.C. [[Xuân Thành Sài Gòn F.C.|Xuân Thành Sài Gòn]] was docked points for what the VFF deemed the club unsportsmanlike conduct when the club fielded a non-competitive squad for their Matchday 20 meeting with [[Sông Lam Nghệ An F.C.|Sông Lam Nghệ An]], club officials announced that the club would withdraw from the league. On 22 August 2013, the VFF approved Xuân Thành Sài Gòn's withdrawal request. Matches where the club was involved were vacated.
